features.title: Import a week's export
features.intent: Importing a week's export yields a draft brief with every claim linked to a source item.
features.serves: differentiator: every claim carries a link to its evidence
acceptance: Importing a sample export produces a draft with each claim carrying at least one evidence link.

features.title: Edit and approve a brief
features.intent: Editing a paragraph and approving produces a copyable final brief.
features.serves: journey step 3: the manager edits inline and copies the approved brief out
acceptance: After an inline edit and approve, the final brief is copyable and reflects the edit.

features.title: Flag unsupported claims
features.intent: A claim with no supporting source is visually flagged, never silently kept.
features.serves: REQ-AC3: unsupported claims must never be silently kept
acceptance: A drafted claim with no linked source item is visually flagged in the review UI.
